scope: Snapshot of derived state plus agent-authored observations. No automatic contract, art or delivery acceptance; reread current PLAR before acting.

caller.file_verification: Declared file bytes matched their SHA-256 at this observation; roles and judgments are agent-authored.
caller.summary: Project started. PX2 store production/characters holds the owner's confirmed choices (32x32, side view, binary alpha, nearest display, dark outline of reference.png, teal/cream roles), the family contract, and the open scout sample task with six saved criteria. plar.txt queues scout, medic and family delivery. The scout's reviewed candidate plan and a creative brief are retained. No PixelLab operation was discoverable, so no executable request, dispatch or candidate exists; the sample is unproduced.

artifacts.role: asset requirements queue: scout, medic, family

issues.summary: No official PixelLab MCP tool or schema is connected in this evaluation session, so the scout request cannot be translated into provider arguments, prepared as a durable job or dispatched.
issues.recovery: In a provider-connected session discover the image/character operation, bind reference.png through its supported image input, write provider_arguments and connection.json, re-point the packet, run pixl_request_review, then pixl_plar_prepare for character.scout.

issues.summary: The exact three-colour palette and the facing direction, ground line and identity landmarks are specialist proposals scoped to the first sample; the destination engine and asset paths are unresolved.
issues.recovery: Review the first scout candidate; confirm or widen the palette and name the destination before the family delivery stage.

integration.summary: No destination or consumer code exists in this project; engine display with nearest-neighbor sampling is retained as a family delivery check.

criteria.scope: Current nominees only; absent verdicts remain unperformed.

production.scope: Derived local state and supplied observations; these facts do not determine assignment status or establish undeclared visual/engine checks.

after_observation.succeeded: Retrieve the actual result and import it against this job's saved output plan; then review the candidate.
after_observation.failed: Retain the failure, compare the current contract and decide whether an explicit new request is needed.
after_observation.pending_or_unknown: Continue observation or reconciliation of the same attempt; retain its provider identity.

resume.refresh: Reread focused PLAR after any observation or state change before following the next operation.
resume.scope: Derived local continuation, not a provider call, authorization or acceptance verdict.
